title: Cosmic Terror and Songbird
description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large ethereal green monster with multiple eyes, wild flowing tentacles and an open screaming mouth, perched on a gnarled branch beside a vibrant blue and orange songbird. Below, a black silhouetted hill shows tiny human figures raising their arms in awe or fear amid floating leaves and flowers, all set against a starry space background with galaxies.
prompt: Surreal cosmic horror scene with a large ethereal green monster made of flowing tentacles and multiple glowing eyes, its mouth wide open in a scream. A realistic blue and orange bird sings on the same gnarled branch decorated with ginkgo leaves and small flowers. Below them a black silhouetted hill with tiny human figures reaching upward, set against a white background filled with swirling galaxies, stars, and cosmic dust in a detailed ink and watercolor style.
